title: Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships: Risk Management
issuer: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation; Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
version: Final guidance, 88 FR 37920 (FR Doc. 2023-12340; Docket OP-1752, OCC-2021-0011)
applicability: Rating: applies only if a particular customer type is served. Binds banking organizations supervised by the Fed, FDIC and OCC, not Echelon. version: Pub. L. 106-102, title V, as amended
applicability: Rating: binds Echelon's customer; flows down by contract or supervisory expectation. Binds 'financial institutions' as defined (entities significantly engaged in financial activities).
